conditions.label: ultralight mass
conditions.description: The assumption that the dark matter particle is extremely light (around 10⁻²² eV), so its de Broglie wavelength reaches galactic scales.

review: Ultralight mass was a separate node that Wave Dark Matter 'assumes'; it is attached here because the long de Broglie wavelength is what makes interference visible. Sophie to confirm it belongs on this edge rather than on 'is a class of Dark Matter'.
